column1: # host: Windows 11 (shared with other sessions; rows vary run to run), stock JDK 21.0.9 + patched java.base (--patch-module); M3HashAtomsPerf: static final MethodHandles bound to the function (invokeExact), corpus 2048 random inputs of length 0..1100, 40 passes per round, warm-up 6, best of 7

# committed-N: M3ByteArrayAccess over jdk.internal.util.ByteArrayLittleEndian (this change), five runs (committed-3: tools/gate.sh; committed-4: after the review fixes of #2232; committed-5: after LITERAL_CONSTANTS, method bytecode identical to committed-4, so its differences are host noise)
# alternative-internal-unsafe: the same rows with M3ByteArrayAccess over jdk.internal.misc.Unsafe getLong/getInt/getShort (NOT committed; isolates the cost of the access)
# speedup = vendored ns/op / absorbed ns/op (above 1: absorbed faster)

# columns since the JIT leaf: median and best of the measured rounds (interleaved A/B), rounds, mean system CPU load; the earlier runs (6-column table) carried over: their single value was the best of 7 rounds

# <variant>-clean-<path>: one JVM per M3HashAtomsPerf row group (bytes, xxh3-64, xxh3-128, string, bytebuffer, access+kernel); <variant>-clean-all: every group in one JVM (shared kernels see every input kind); variants: before = 32f8e561b29 (the absorption before review), split = XXH3_SPLIT v1 only, v2 = + UNSAFE_TO_BYTE_ARRAY v2 + FACADE_ENTRY_CHECK v1, after = + ACCESS_SHORT_NAMES v1 (this change before the merge of the review commits, whose LITERAL_CONSTANTS step leaves method bytecode unchanged); tools/jit_gate.sh

# diag-<d>-r<n>, diag3-<d>-r<n>: diagnostic builds on top of the split (scratch, NOT committed), two repetitions: d1 = every byte[] read through jdk.internal.misc.Unsafe behind its own Preconditions.checkIndex (ByteArrayLittleEndian's check), d2 = the same reads unchecked, d3 = a checked and an unchecked instance chosen by a final field per read
# after-merged-gate-all: the perf step of tools/gate.sh on this change merged with the review commits (every group in one JVM)

# <variant>-r1-clean-<path>, <variant>-r1-clean-all (the fix of the JIT leaf, after its verification): the same paths on the merged build, before = 827c4b65f73 (the leaf's base), after = this leaf; tools/jit_gate.sh (r2 and r3 ran with M3_JIT_CLEAN=0: JIT logs only, JIT.tsv)

# repro-<variant>-r<n>: tools/perf_variants.py, the decision variants rebuilt from the repository (split, d1, d2, d3, v2, after; groups bytes, xxh3-64, xxh3-128 in one JVM, interleaved); they replace the scratch diag-* and diag3-* rows as the evidence of record (d3 does not reproduce, see README)

# repro-base-r<n>, repro-unsafe-r<n>: tools/perf_variants.py variants base (827c4b65f73) and unsafe (base + the leaf's byte[] access: the absorption's alternative-internal-unsafe, reproducible), interleaved, two rounds

# reproall-<variant>-r<n>: tools/perf_variants.py with M3_PERF_GROUPS = every group (one JVM: the shared kernels see every input kind), variants split, v2, after, interleaved, two rounds: the evidence for ACCESS_SHORT_NAMES v1
